name: Sonos One (gen2) floorstands
description:
This is a Sonos One (generation 2) floor stand mount that you might use in a surround sound setup where the speakers are the rear left and right channels.
I should say up front there are more than 3d printed parts in this design and a degree of fabrication required. The main posts (as detailed below) are clothes rails that can be purchased in 32mm OD in a number of finishes, I chose chrome. The mains connection to the speakers will pass through the post (just) but will need to exit it at the top via a side slot, this MUST be edged with a grommet (printed one below) so that the cable is protected from chafing. Do not shortcut this step for your safety, and always work with the cable un plugged from the mains electrical supply.
The base plate is listed as a .dxf file which can be sent for Laser cutting. I used used Mild Steel for this which I spray painted.
The printed parts are "as printed", no post print processes were carried out. The screw "spikes" are M6 screws and fit the four corners of the base where the 5mm holes are, they need to be tapped M6. Full printing, manufacturing and assembly instruction PDF in Thingfiles. 

Proprietary speaker stands of this design cost about £120, these cost £40 approx..
